# Cancellation and Refund Rules
Quillbrook Village Hall is a fictional organisation.

## 1. Scope
1.1 These rules were adopted on 12 February 2025.
1.2 They apply to accepted bookings under hall-bookings.md.
1.3 Cancellation requests must be submitted in writing.
1.4 The date the booking officer receives the request is the cancellation date.

## 2. Hirer cancellations
2.1 Cancellation at least 28 calendar days before the event gives a full refund.
2.2 Cancellation from 14 to 27 calendar days before the event gives a 50% refund.
2.3 Cancellation fewer than 14 calendar days before the event gives no refund.
2.4 The refund percentages apply to room, kitchen and equipment hire charges.
2.5 The £30 booking deposit is non-refundable in every hirer cancellation.
2.6 Refunds under 2.1 and 2.2 exclude the booking deposit.
2.7 An unpaid balance remains payable if the cancellation charge exceeds payments.

## 3. Hall cancellations
3.1 If the committee cancels an event, all payments are refunded.
3.2 This includes bookings cancelled for safety reasons under hall-safety.md.
3.3 The committee does not pay compensation for external costs.
3.4 The booking officer must notify the hirer as soon as reasonably possible.

## 4. Damage deposits
4.1 Damage deposits are returned within ten working days after the event.
4.2 Documented repair or additional cleaning costs may be deducted.
4.3 The hirer must receive an itemised statement of deductions.
4.4 Any disputed deduction is reviewed by two trustees.
4.5 An unused damage deposit is returned in full after hirer cancellation.

## 5. Refund processing
5.1 Refunds are made by bank transfer.
5.2 Approved refunds must be issued within 15 working days.
5.3 The treasurer records every refund in the payment ledger.
5.4 Refund approvals above £500 require two trustees.
5.5 Working days mean Monday to Friday, excluding public holidays.

# Committee Changes Register
Quillbrook Village Hall is a fictional organisation.

## 1. How to use this register
1.1 These entries replace only the named governing sections.
1.2 All other governing wording remains unchanged.
1.3 The original governing documents retain their adopted wording.
1.4 Entries apply from their effective dates, not their decision dates.

## 2. Decision made 18 September 2025
2.1 Effective 1 November 2025: replace hall-fees.md section 2.1.
2.2 Main Hall hire is £28 per hour instead of £24.
2.3 Controlling date: the first date of the booked event.

## 3. Decision made 15 January 2026
3.1 Effective 1 February 2026: replace hall-fees.md section 3.1.
3.2 Registered village groups receive 25% off room hire instead of 20%.
3.3 Controlling date: the first date of the booked event.

## 4. Decision made 15 January 2026
4.1 Effective 1 March 2026: replace hall-bookings.md section 3.1.
4.2 Monday to Thursday opening hours become 08:00 to 21:30.
4.3 Controlling date: the date on which room use takes place.

## 5. Decision made 20 March 2026
5.1 Effective 1 April 2026: replace hall-conduct.md section 4.1.
5.2 Friday and Saturday amplified music must stop by 21:30.
5.3 Controlling date: the date on which the music is played.

## 6. Decision made 14 May 2026
6.1 Effective 1 June 2026: replace hall-refunds.md section 2.2.
6.2 Cancellation from 14 to 27 days before the event gives a 25% refund.
6.3 Controlling date: when the booking officer receives cancellation.
6.4 The separate booking deposit exclusion still applies.

## 7. Decision made 14 May 2026
7.1 Effective 1 July 2026: replace hall-safety.md section 5.1.

7.3 Controlling date: when the emergency spending is authorised.

You get back £100, which is the damage deposit. None of the £150 hire charge is refunded.

- **Hire charge:** The cancellation date is when the booking officer received the request, 10 September 2025. That is 10 calendar days before the 20 September event. Cancelling fewer than 14 days before gives no refund (hall-refunds.md, 2.3 and 1.4). The £30 booking deposit is non-refundable in any case (hall-refunds.md, 2.5).
- **Damage deposit:** An unused damage deposit is returned in full after a hirer cancellation (hall-refunds.md, 4.5).
- **Changes register:** The change to section 2.2 (hall-changes.md, section 6) takes effect on 1 June 2026. It doesn't apply to a cancellation received in 2025, and it concerns the 14 to 27 day band, not this case.
